source_files.role: The oracle. Every transcribed literal in tests/percolator_infile.rs comes from this file's five sections.

Not ported as a class. Read for getRegExFromNativeID's prefix table and extractScanNumber's last-match / conversion-error semantics, which ScanNumberPattern reproduces without a regular-expression dependency.

Not ported here (src/chemistry/sequence.rs already covers it, minus toBracketString). Read for toBracketString(integer_mass=false, mass_delta=true), which bracket_sequence reproduces for the Peptide column.

fixtures.role: Unmodified upstream. Sage-flavoured .pin: 34 columns including FileName, rank, z=2..z=6 and z=other, and nine data rows over two raw files. Row 8 is labelled target but maps only to a DECOY_-prefixed protein, which is the reannotation the class test checks.

Derived, not upstream. A minimal three-row .pin named so that the source's sibling-path derivation resolves: stripping 'pin' gives the .tsv and stripping 'results.sage.pin' gives the matched-fragments prefix. No upstream fixture exercises the SageAnnotation path at all.
Derived. The sibling Sage .tsv, whose spectrum_q column filters rows; its second row is 0.5, above the 0.01 default threshold.

Derived. The sibling Sage annotation file, with two fragments for psm_id 0 and one for psm_id 2, using the column names the source reads: psm_id, fragment_type, fragment_ordinals, fragment_charge, fragment_intensity, fragment_mz_experimental.

source_anchors.operation: getStandardFeatureSet is the column contract: SpecId, Label, ScanNr, ExpMass, CalcMass, mass, peplen, then charge<c> for c in [min,max], then enzN, enzC, enzInt, dm, absdm. A max_charge below min_charge yields no charge column, and the span is otherwise unbounded
getScanIdentifier prefers the spectrum reference, falls back to 'scan=' + the spectrum_id meta value, then to 'index=' + the index, and finally removes all whitespace
the Sage sibling .tsv path is StringUtils::substr(pin_file, 0, pin_file.size()-3) + "tsv": an unchecked byte-offset slice of the path string

the Sage annotation path subtracts the length of the literal "results.sage.pin" (16) from the path size without checking that the path is at least that long, so a shorter path wraps the unsigned subtraction, and a multi-byte path can be cut inside a character
a row whose column count differs from the header throws Exception::ParseError naming the line
the FileName column is optional here, filling map_filename_to_idx only when it exists
a new identification is opened when the row's SpecId differs from the previous one, which starts as an empty string; a first row with an empty SpecId therefore calls pids.back() on an empty vector

map_filename_to_idx.at(raw_file_name) is reached unconditionally, so a .pin file with no FileName column looks up the never-inserted default name 'UNKNOWN' and terminates the process with std::out_of_range
the retention time is multiplied by 60 because search engines typically write minutes; the retentiontime column is read with .at and is therefore mandatory in practice
ScanNr becomes the spectrum reference, which may be an integer or a whole vendor identifier
the one-hot charge columns are iterated from an unordered_map and the loop breaks at the first column equal to "1", so a row with two columns set picks an unspecified charge
the identification m/z is ExpMass / |charge| + PROTON_MASS_U, and is left unset when no charge could be determined
']-' becomes '].' and '-[' becomes '.[' before AASequence::fromString, so Percolator's terminal bracket spelling parses
a 'ln(-poisson)' value of 'inf' is replaced by '3.5' as a Sage workaround; extra scores are stored as strings, not numbers
the scan-number regex is derived from the first identification's scan identifier and then applied to all of them
stamp_meta_value records only keys the hit did not already have, so a caller can remove adapter-generated values without touching input metadata of the same name
a hit with no PeptideEvidence, and a hit whose target/decoy status is UNKNOWN, are skipped and their (pid, hit) indices returned
an existing CalcMass meta value is reused; otherwise it is the sequence m/z at the hit's charge

an IsotopeError meta value (the legacy MS-GF+ adapter spelling before 2.6) or the current isotope_error shifts ExpMass by isoErr * C13C12_MASSDIFF_U / charge, dividing by a charge that is not checked for zero
the charge<i> features are stamped with a bool, which DataValue has no alternative for and therefore promotes to an int, so the column reads 1 or 0
enzN and enzC are computed from the raw flanking markers, before the '[' and ']' markers are mapped to Percolator's '-' at line 534, so a protein-terminal PSM is reported as non-enzymatic
StringUtils::prefix(unmodified_sequence, 1)[0] and suffix(..., 1)[0] index the first and last byte of the unmodified sequence, which reads past the end for an empty peptide
the Proteins field joins the accessions with tabs, so the trailing protein list occupies as many columns as the hit has evidences
preparePin_ writes a row only when every declared feature has a meta value; a short hit is counted and dropped, and the missing names are logged
isEnz_'s per-enzyme table, including the '-' terminus shortcut and the else branch that makes every bond enzymatic for an unknown enzyme name
countEnzymatic_ counts internal bonds by indexing the peptide string per byte
scan=, controllerType=, function= and frame= all select the 'scan=(\\d+)' pattern; index=, scanId=, scanID=, spectrum= and file= select their own; anything else falls back to a bare '(\\d+)'
extractScanNumber takes the last match and swallows a ConversionError, returning -1 when no_error is set

toBracketString writes an N-terminal annotation as n[...] and a C-terminal one as c[...], with a '+' prefix only when the relative mass is positive; a modified X residue falls back to its absolute internal mass with no sign

evidence: Tier 3 source review. The expectations in tests/percolator_infile.rs are transcribed class-test literals from PercolatorInfile_test.cpp: the exact ordered feature sets for charges 2-4 and 3-3, the assembled header beginning with SpecId and ending with Peptide, Proteins, and the written row's SpecId 'scan=529', ScanNr '529', Label '1', peplen '7', charge2 '1', charge3 '0', enzN '1', enzC '1', Peptide 'K.SAMPLER.S' and Proteins 'PROT1'; plus, for the reader, 9 identifications, 2 filenames, the spectrum references '30381' and 'spectrum=2041', and the DECOY_ reannotation of the eighth entry. Transcribed literals are tier-3 evidence: they detect transcription drift but cannot falsify a misread algorithm. No C++ was built or executed and no C++ output was retained, so nothing here is tier 1 or 2. The per-enzyme specificity table, the scan-number pattern table, the isotope-error shift, the bracket rendering, the Sage annotation path, the non-ASCII inputs and the resource ceilings are independently derived (tier 4) from the implementation, since the class test reaches none of them.
gaps: The source's SageAnnotation path also reads a 'peptide' column that it never uses, and it re-reads spectrum_q twice per row (once to filter, once to stamp). Both are reproduced in behaviour, not in shape.

load's decoy_prefix reannotation compares the prefix with StringUtils::hasPrefix on each accession. This port uses str::starts_with, which is byte-identical for the ASCII prefixes adapters pass; a non-ASCII prefix behaves the same because both compare bytes.

toBracketString is a member of AASequence.h, which this package does not own. bracket_sequence reimplements only the (integer_mass=false, mass_delta=true) form the .pin writer needs, and returns Error::Unsupported for a modified X residue whose absolute internal mass the crate cannot resolve. The fixed_modifications filter argument is not reproduced, because PercolatorInfile never passes it.
The source parallelises nothing here, so there is no OpenMP gap to record for this header.
